global_days_idle.cohort: two samples per training bout (A and B); days since prior bout in any division (from full fight chronology, strictly before fight_date); same decisive rows as matchup_features

elo_by_division.cohort_note: one sample per (fighter_id, division) seen on fight records; excludes UNKNOWN

notes: matchup_features + division_elo + global_days_idle: 101-point empirical quantiles for mma.ai (reference_distributions.json). chart_histograms: optional bin/count payloads for SPA.
